title: Financial market high-low volatility spillover and portfolio allocation: a time frequency analysis
title_zh: 金融市场高低波动溢出与投资组合配置：时频分析
authors: Agudamu Qi, Ying Yuan, Peng Liu
abstract: This study explores the high- and low-volatility spillover effects and portfolio allocation from a frequency-domain perspective across the stock, bond, forex, gold, and oil markets. Specifically, we decompose realized volatility into high- and low-volatility regimes and analyse volatility spillovers from both short- and long-term components using the TVP-VAR frequency connectedness approach. In addition, we employ four portfolio strategies to evaluate cumulative returns and hedging effectiveness. This results reveal significant differences in spillover effects between high- and low-volatility networks: short-term spillovers dominate in high-volatility networks, whereas long-term spillovers are the main contributors in low-volatility networks. Furthermore, the portfolio constructed using the minimum connectedness approach (MCoP) exhibits the highest cumulative returns, whereas the minimum variance portfolio (MVP) and risk parity portfolio (RPP) achieve stronger hedging effectiveness. Overall, this study highlights the importance of jointly considering volatility intensity and time-frequency characteristics when assessing cross-market risk transmission and designing portfolio strategies.
abstract_zh: 本研究从频域视角探讨了股票、债券、外汇、黄金及石油市场间的高、低波动溢出效应与资产配置策略。具体而言，我们将已实现波动率分解为高波动与低波动状态，并采用TVP-VAR频域关联方法，从短期与长期成分两个维度分析波动溢出效应。此外，我们运用四种投资组合策略评估累计收益与对冲有效性。研究结果显示，高波动与低波动网络中的溢出效应存在显著差异：高波动网络中短期溢出占主导地位，而低波动网络中长期溢出为主要贡献因素。进一步发现，基于最小关联法构建的投资组合（MCoP）具有最高的累计收益，而最小方差组合（MVP）与风险平价组合（RPP）则展现出更强的对冲有效性。总体而言，本研究强调了在评估跨市场风险传导与设计投资组合策略时，需同时考虑波动强度与时间-频率特征的重要性。

title: Firm Exit and Financial Frictions
title_zh: 企业退出与金融摩擦
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Governments often intervene to prevent firm closures during crises, fearing that financially constrained but viable firms may fail. We develop a firm dynamics model with incomplete financial markets and show how financial frictions generate excessive firm exit. A key statistic governing this dynamic inefficiency is the marginal propensity to exit with debt. Using confidential U.S. Census data, we estimate the relationship between debt and exit and use it to discipline the model. The calibrated model implies that eliminating financial frictions reduces firm exit from 9.3\% to 5.0\% and generates welfare gains of 3.6\% in consumption-equivalent terms. We show that the welfare costs of financial frictions rise sharply during financial crises but change little during standard productivity recessions. Finally, we compare government-guaranteed loans and grants, quantifying the trade-off between fiscal cost and effectiveness in preventing excessive exit.
abstract_zh: 政府常会在危机期间干预以防止企业倒闭，担心那些面临财务约束但具有生存能力的企业可能失败。我们构建了一个包含不完全金融市场的企业动态模型，并展示了金融摩擦如何导致企业过度退出。衡量这种动态低效率的关键统计指标是债务驱动的边际退出倾向。利用保密的美国人口普查数据，我们估算了债务与退出之间的关系，并以此校准模型。校准后的模型表明，消除金融摩擦可使企业退出率从9.3%降至5.0%，并以消费等价形式带来3.6%的福利收益。我们进一步发现，金融摩擦的福利成本在金融危机期间急剧上升，但在标准的生产率衰退期间变化甚微。最后，我们比较了政府担保贷款与直接拨款，量化了财政成本与防止过度退出有效性之间的权衡关系。

title: Design of Partial Population Experiments with an Application to Spillovers in Tax Compliance
title_zh: 部分总体实验设计及其在税收合规溢出效应中的应用
authors: Guillermo Cruces, Dario Tortarolo, Gonzalo Vazquez-Bare
official: 官方在线 2026-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a framework to analyze partial population experiments, a generalization of the cluster experimental design where clusters are assigned to different treatment intensities. The framework allows for heterogeneity in cluster sizes and outcome distributions. The paper studies the large-sample behavior of OLS estimators and cluster-robust variance estimators and shows that (i) ignoring cluster heterogeneity may result in severely underpowered experiments and (ii) the cluster-robust variance estimator may be upward-biased when clusters are heterogeneous. The paper derives formulas for power, minimum detectable effects, and optimal cluster assignment probabilities. All the results apply to cluster experiments, a particular case of the framework. The paper sets up a potential outcomes framework to interpret the OLS estimands as causal effects. It implements the methods in a large-scale experiment to estimate the direct and spillover effects of a communication campaign on property tax compliance. The analysis reveals an increase in tax compliance among individuals directly targeted with the mailing, as well as compliance spillovers on untreated individuals in clusters with a high proportion of treated taxpayers.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析部分总体实验的框架，这是对聚类实验设计的一种推广，其中聚类被分配至不同的处理强度。该框架允许聚类规模与结果分布存在异质性。本文研究了OLS估计量及聚类稳健方差估计量的大样本性质，并表明：（i）忽略聚类异质性可能导致实验统计功效严重不足；（ii）当聚类存在异质性时，聚类稳健方差估计量可能存在向上偏误。本文推导了统计功效、最小可检测效应及最优聚类分配概率的公式。所有结论均适用于聚类实验（该框架的一个特例）。本文构建了一个潜在结果框架，将OLS估计量解释为因果效应。通过一项大规模实验实施该方法，用以估计通信宣传对财产税合规性的直接效应与溢出效应。分析显示，直接收到邮件的个体税收合规性有所提升，且在受处理纳税人比例较高的聚类中，未受处理的个体也出现了合规性溢出效应。

title: Can Online Activity Be Regulated? Evidence from Adult Websites
title_zh: 网络活动能否被监管？来自成人网站的证据
authors: Matthew Brown, Emily J. Davis, Devin G. Pope
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The consequences of online regulations depend on the extent to which users can circumvent restrictions or substitute toward noncompliant platforms. Since 2023, 25 U.S. states have implemented age verification laws that caused prominent adult websites (including Pornhub) to restrict local access for all users. We study how these restrictions affected browsing activity using individual-level panel data. Access restrictions reduced overall time spent on adult sites by roughly 10%. Specifically, for every 100 hours spent on top adult sites before restrictions, about 50 hours remained accessible at noncompliant sites that never restricted access, 30 hours persisted through VPN-based circumvention, 10 hours were substituted from compliant sites to noncompliant sites, and 10 hours were no longer spent on adult sites.
abstract_zh: 网络监管的效果取决于用户规避限制或转向不合规平台的程度。自2023年以来，美国25个州实施了年龄验证法律，导致知名成人网站（包括Pornhub）对所有用户限制本地访问。我们利用个体层面面板数据研究了这些限制对浏览活动的影响。访问限制使成人网站总浏览时间减少约10%。具体而言，在限制实施前每100小时成人网站浏览时间中，约50小时仍可通过从未限制访问的不合规网站获取，30小时通过VPN规避持续存在，10小时从合规网站转向不合规网站，另有10小时不再用于访问成人网站。

title: Market integration and the impact of violence on trade networks: Evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 市场整合与暴力对贸易网络的影响：来自尼日利亚的证据
authors: Jiawen Liu, Michael Olabisi, Mywish K Maredia
abstract: Market integration is critical for food security in developing economies facing socio-political instability. Using weekly price data from ninety-seven Nigerian markets, this study investigates how violent conflict influences price dynamics between market pairs. Results reveal that frequent violent events have limited short-term effects on price transmission, and changes in conflict intensity do not significantly disrupt price adjustments. Markets with stronger trade connections demonstrate greater resilience by leveraging alternative trade routes. These findings highlight the role of market connectivity in maintaining trade efficiency, suggesting that policies that enhance market networks can strengthen resilience and improve food security.
abstract_zh: 市场整合对于面临社会政治动荡的发展中经济体的粮食安全至关重要。本研究利用尼日利亚97个市场的周度价格数据，考察暴力冲突如何影响市场对之间的价格动态。结果显示，频繁的暴力事件对价格传导的短期影响有限，冲突强度的变化并未显著干扰价格调整。贸易联系较强的市场通过利用替代贸易路线展现出更强的韧性。这些发现凸显了市场连通性在维持贸易效率中的作用，表明增强市场网络的政策能够强化韧性并改善粮食安全。
